hero.heading: Our Workplace
hero.subheading: A place where hospitality is a calling, not just a job.

intro.heading: We believe the guest experience begins with the team experience.
intro.body: At Stonetrail Villas, we have built a workplace where people feel valued, trusted, and inspired to do their best work every day. Our team is small enough that every person matters — and large enough that there is always room to grow.

items.title: Care & Belonging
items.body: We treat every team member as family. A culture of genuine care — for guests, for each other, and for the community — is the foundation everything else is built on.

items.title: Collaboration
items.body: Great hospitality is a team effort. We share knowledge, support one another across departments, and celebrate wins together.

items.title: Sustainability
items.body: We are stewards of St. Vincent and the Grenadines. Our team leads by example — protecting the natural beauty that makes this place extraordinary.

items.title: Excellence
items.body: We hold ourselves to a high standard — not out of pressure, but out of pride. Every detail matters because our guests deserve nothing less.
